visual_logic: Highlights the completely toothless, straight, razor-edged predatory javelin beak morphology of Cryodrakon.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of a complete Cryodrakon 'Stout Spear' beak, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized, and slightly rounded edges. The toothless jaw profile forms a perfectly rigid, straight, weapon-like dagger structure with a knife-sharp cutting edge along the margin. The texture is a smooth, high-quality matte keratin sheath with subtle silver-grey, cool grey, and charcoal tones reflecting its snowy habitat palette. The specimen is oriented horizontally and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, carefully scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space safety margin on all four sides. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to define the clean, unyielding linear edge of the weapon.
